pins.name: VIN
pins.notes: Pin order and labels differ between sellers: check the silkscreen

pins.name: AD0
pins.notes: Address select: LOW = 0x68, HIGH = 0x69 (some boards pull it HIGH)

pins.name: CS
pins.notes: SPI chip select. Leave unconnected or HIGH for I2C

pins.name: FSYNC
pins.notes: Frame sync. Leave unconnected or tie to GND

sources.title: TDK InvenSense ICM-20948 datasheet
sources.section: I2C slave address b110100X, X = AD0 (0x68 / 0x69); VDD 1.71 to 3.6 V
